audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t both cite a 62.75% win rate; the packet says 48.11% over 212 games.
audit.why: One number, from the data. 48.11% does not support a FAVOURED / 4/10 label.

Ryze owns levels 1-2 and the 2+ item window, Yi owns 4 through first item — the chart itself reads even, and the win rate agrees. The mirror audit (ryze side) recorded the same read at roughly 5.5/10.
audit.corrected: EVEN, 5/10. Early belongs to Ryze's 1000-range Overload; Yi takes over at Wuju Style plus first on-hit item; Ryze reclaims fights at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] and spikes[0].text claim Highlander (R) is available at level 3-4.
audit.why: Highlander is the ultimate — level 6, 85s cooldown. The level 3-5 spike is Wuju Style's true damage plus Meditate sustain, not R.
audit.corrected: Level 3-5 spike is Wuju Style (E) true damage and Meditate; level 6 is Highlander; the hard spike is the first on-hit item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Repeated references to a Ryze 'W shield' / 'shielded burst', and the root combo stated backwards as Q-E / W-into-E.
audit.why: Ryze's kit has no shield: W is Rune Prison (damage + slow), and it only ROOTS if the target already carries Flux from Spell Flux (E). So the sequence is E first, then W. Also Meditate is a channel and Rune Prison's CC cancels it (missingInteractions), and Highlander grants slow immunity only — it does nothing against a root.
audit.corrected: No shield anywhere. E applies Flux, W becomes a root (9-11s cooldown); W cancels Meditate; Highlander's immunity covers slows, not roots; Alpha Strike's untargetability frames dodge his burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on the punishable window.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s — the only thing that stops Alpha Strike being your out.
audit.corrected: All-in inside the 9-11s while W is down.

edits.before: Ryze's Overload (Q) poke and Rune Prison (W) root beat you at level 1.
edits.after: Ryze's Overload (Q) reaches 1000 units and pokes you off CS at level 1.

edits.before: His W root into E combo keeps you off him at level 2.
edits.after: Spell Flux (E) into Rune Prison (W) roots you at level 2.

edits.before: At level 3 your Highlander (R) access makes trades even.
edits.after: At level 3 Wuju Style (E) true damage evens short trades.

edits.before: Through level 4-5 you all-in when his W root is down and win.
edits.after: At 4-5 you all-in inside the 9-11s his Rune Prison (W) is down.

edits.before: Late game his shielded burst and W root swing teamfights back to Ryze.
edits.after: Late his mana-stacked burst and W root swing teamfights back to Ryze.

edits.before: Ryze pokes hard early with Overload (Q) and Rune Prison (W) root chaining into Spell Flux (E), but by level 4 you have Highlander (R) and can Alpha Strike (Q) onto him once his W root is on cooldown.
edits.after: Ryze pokes with Overload (Q), and Rune Prison (W) only roots you if Spell Flux (E) put Flux on you first - otherwise it is a slow. From level 4 Wuju Style (E) true damage lets you all-in the 9-11s his W is down.

edits.before: With Kraken/BORK done you dominate the 1v1: pop Highlander (R) to cleanse his slow and Alpha Strike (Q) through the moment his Rune Prison (W) is down, and he cannot out-DPS your on-hit.
edits.after: With Kraken/BORK done you dominate the 1v1: Highlander (R) makes you immune to his slow and Alpha Strike (Q) goes untargetable through his burst, so save its 20s for the moment he commits Flux onto you.

edits.before: Late game swings back to Ryze in teamfights - his shielded, high-mana burst and Realm Warp (R) plays matter more at scale, and if he lands a W root on you in a fight you can get bursted before Highlander saves you.
edits.after: Late game swings back to Ryze in teamfights - his mana-stacked burst and Realm Warp (R) plays matter more at scale, and a Flux-empowered W root holds you still, because Highlander's immunity covers slows and not roots.

edits.before: Ryze pokes you out at levels 1-2: Overload (Q) chunks you and Rune Prison (W) can root you into a Spell Flux (E) combo. Respect his root cooldown, farm from a safe distance, and don't walk into a W that sets up his full burst.
edits.after: Ryze pokes you out at levels 1-2: Overload (Q) reaches 1000 units, and Rune Prison (W) only roots once Spell Flux (E) has applied Flux. Never Meditate (W) while his W is up - it cancels the channel outright, so sustain only after he spends it.

edits.before: By level 3-6 the lane swings to you. Highlander (R) gives the movement speed to close, and once his Rune Prison (W) is down you Alpha Strike (Q) onto him and out-trade his cooldowns. His level 6 Realm Warp (R) is utility, not a duel tool, so you hold kill pressure through this stretch.
edits.after: By level 3-6 the lane swings to you. Wuju Style (E) true damage ignores his MR, and once Rune Prison (W) is down for its 9-11s you Alpha Strike (Q) in and out-trade his cooldowns. His level 6 Realm Warp (R) is utility, not a duel tool, so you hold kill pressure through this stretch.

edits.before: The 2-item mark tilts back to Ryze in fights. His shielded, mana-scaling burst and Realm Warp (R) roams matter at scale, and a landed W root can chain-burst you before Highlander (R) bails you out. Force the 1v1 sidelane where you still win rather than diving him in a grouped fight.
edits.after: The 2-item mark tilts back to Ryze in fights. His mana-scaling burst and Realm Warp (R) roams matter at scale, and a Flux-empowered W root pins you while Highlander (R) only cancels slows. Force the 1v1 sidelane where you still win rather than diving him in a grouped fight.

edits.before: Poke you down with Overload (Q) and chain Rune Prison (W) root into E
edits.after: Poke with Overload (Q), then Spell Flux (E) to make his W a root

edits.before: Scale into a shielded burst carry who wins late teamfights
edits.after: Scale into a mana-stacked burst carry who wins late fights

edits.before: FAVOURED
edits.after: EVEN

edits.before: Farm with Alpha Strike and Wuju autos through his early poke, hit Kraken Slayer or Blade of the Ruined King, then use Highlander plus Q's untargetability to dodge his root combo and out-DPS him in melee range. Every kill resets Highlander and shaves your cooldowns, so chain him before his W shield and resets stack up.
edits.after: Farm with Alpha Strike and Wuju autos through his early poke, hit Kraken Slayer or Blade of the Ruined King, then use Highlander plus Q's untargetability to dodge his Flux-into-root combo and out-DPS him in melee. Every kill resets Highlander and shaves your cooldowns, so chain him inside the 9-11s Rune Prison is down.

edits.before: Bait his Q-E root into the wave, Alpha Strike onto him as it whiffs, then E Wuju Style + on-hit autos under Highlander to burst him before his shield refreshes.
edits.after: Bait his Spell Flux and Rune Prison into the wave, Alpha Strike on as it whiffs, then E Wuju Style + on-hit autos under Highlander before his W's 9-11s is back.

edits.before: Kraken Slayer / Blade of the Ruined King on-hit DPS shreds his low base HP faster than his W shield and resets can answer.
edits.after: Kraken Slayer / Blade of the Ruined King on-hit DPS shreds his low base HP faster than his Overload resets can answer.

edits.before: At 2+ items you out-DPS Ryze in any extended melee fight: Alpha Strike dodges his root, on-hit shreds through his W shield, and every kill resets Highlander to chain. But Ryze is a hard scaler — if he reaches full build uncaught, his raid-boss damage and root chain reclaim fights, so close the game on your item spike.
edits.after: At 2+ items you out-DPS Ryze in any extended melee fight: Alpha Strike's untargetable frames dodge his burst, Wuju true damage ignores his MR, and every kill resets Highlander to chain. But Ryze is a hard scaler — if he reaches full build uncaught, his mana-stacked damage and root chain reclaim fights, so close on your item spike.

edits.before: It's only 4/10 because the lolalytics 62.75% win rate reflects how decisively you flip it post-item — the early poke and root are real, but they don't beat you hard enough to stop you scaling past him.
edits.after: It's 5/10 because the 48.11% win rate over 212 games says even, not free — his early poke and Flux root are real, and you only flip the lane once your first on-hit item and Highlander let you close the gap.

edits.before: After he whiffs or burns Q-E into the wave, that's your window — E Wuju Style true damage plus on-hit melts his low base HP before his shield and resets recover.
edits.after: After he burns Spell Flux and Rune Prison into the wave, that's your window — E Wuju Style true damage plus on-hit melts his low base HP inside the 9-11s his W is down.

edits.before: Channeling Meditate inside his root or Q poke just feeds him free damage and locks you in place; only sustain when he's out of spells.
edits.after: Rune Prison cancels the Meditate channel outright and refunds him nothing; only sustain once his W is spent, never while it is up and you are in Flux range.

edits.before: FAVOURED (4/10 difficulty, 62.75% WR) — eat the early poke, hit your item, and Alpha Strike through his root to run down a scaler who can't kite you anymore.
edits.after: EVEN (5/10 difficulty, 48.11% WR) — eat the early poke, hit your item, and Alpha Strike through his root to run down a scaler who can no longer kite you off.

notes: Ryze has no shield in his kit; every 'W shield' / 'shielded burst' reference across this matchup was fabricated and is corrected here. Root order was also backwards throughout: Spell Flux (E) applies Flux, and only then does Rune Prison (W) root instead of slow. Level chart matches the packet exactly, so no chart edits. tone left unchanged (#3ddc97) despite the diff moving to EVEN — I do not know the approved colour token for EVEN.
